en_title: Nicolas Cage Says He'll 'Probably Never Work With' Amazon Again After Declining Spider-Noir AI Waiver
cn_title: 凯奇拒签AI授权，或告别亚马逊
subtitle: 不让机器人替我们做梦
opus_summary: 尼古拉斯·凯奇拒签《Spider-Noir》的AI使用授权书，称可能不再与亚马逊合作。他在纽约漫展重申反对AI的立场，并赞赏坚持亲手创作的年轻导演。

paragraphs.en: Nicolas Cage said he'll "probably not work with" Amazon again after declining to sign a waiver to use AI on Spider-Noir .
paragraphs.cn: 尼古拉斯·凯奇拒绝签署允许在《暗影蜘蛛侠》中使用AI的授权书后，表示自己「可能不会再与」亚马逊合作。

paragraphs.en: The National Treasure actor made his position on the controversial technology clear during a New York Comic Con 2026 panel attended by IGN. His work on Amazon's Prime Video Spider-Noir show officially came to an end when the Marvel project was canceled last month, but it doesn't sound like he would have been too excited to return for a second season anyway.
paragraphs.cn: 这位《国家宝藏》演员在2026年纽约漫展的一场座谈会上，明确表达了自己对这项争议技术的立场，IGN也参加了这场活动。上个月，亚马逊Prime Video的漫威剧集《暗影蜘蛛侠》被取消，凯奇在该剧的工作也正式结束。不过，听他的说法，即便有第二季，他似乎也不会太期待回归。

paragraphs.en: "Amazon is a very AI-friendly company, to the tune of $50 billion invested in OpenAI . I'm not an AI-friendly actor," Cage said. "I'm not part of their club. I didn't sign the waiver to use AI on Spider-Noir. I'll probably not work with that studio again, but that's OK."
paragraphs.cn: 凯奇说：「亚马逊是一家非常支持AI的公司，对OpenAI的投资高达500亿美元(约合人民币3350亿元)。我不是一个支持AI的演员。」「我不是他们圈子里的人。我没有签署允许在《暗影蜘蛛侠》中使用AI的授权书。我可能不会再与那家制片公司合作了，不过没关系。」

paragraphs.en: Cage is far from a newcomer to the growing list of Hollywood talent to come out against AI in recent years. In early 2025, the actor used the Saturn Awards as an opportunity to speak against artificial intelligence, saying he's "a big believer in not letting robots dream for us."
paragraphs.cn: 近年来，越来越多好莱坞从业者公开反对AI，凯奇早已是其中一员。2025年初，他在土星奖颁奖典礼上发声反对人工智能，称自己「坚信不该让机器人替我们做梦」。

paragraphs.en: "Robots cannot reflect the human condition for us," he continued. "That is a dead end if an actor lets one AI robot manipulate his or her performance even a little bit, an inch will eventually become a mile and all integrity, purity, and truth of art will be replaced by financial interests only. We can’t let that happen."
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「机器人无法替我们反映人类的处境。如果演员允许AI机器人操纵自己的表演，哪怕只有一点点，那也是一条死路。最初的一寸最终会变成一英里，艺术的完整性、纯粹性与真实性都将被取代，剩下的只有经济利益。我们不能让这种事发生。」

paragraphs.en: He also told The New Yorker that he was "terrified" of AI in 2024. Now that Cage is likely writing off working with Amazon, it sounds like he's putting his money where his mouth is.
paragraphs.cn: 2024年，他也曾对《纽约客》表示，AI让他「感到恐惧」。如今，凯奇很可能不再考虑与亚马逊合作，看来他正在用行动兑现自己的话。

paragraphs.en: Cage isn't just avoiding AI; he's also backing other anti-AI filmmakers. One fresh face in the Hollywood scene that he had kind words for at NYCC was YouTuber-turned-director Kane Parsons. The budding moviemaker behind Backrooms previously called attention to the " genuinely harmful consequences " generative AI has inflicted on society, and now, Cage just so happens to be a fan.
paragraphs.cn: 凯奇不仅避开AI，也支持其他反对AI的电影人。在纽约漫展上，他称赞了一位好莱坞新人：从油管主转型为导演的Kane Parsons。这位《后室》的新锐导演此前曾呼吁人们关注生成式AI给社会带来的「切实的危害」，而凯奇恰好也是他的欣赏者。

paragraphs.en: "I got to get with these young directors who are, you know, Gen Z, and they're going in it their own way, whether it's through the YouTube culture or whatever it is," the actor said. "They're doing it from scratch by hand. I wanna get with that."
paragraphs.cn: 凯奇说：「我得和这些年轻导演合作，你知道，他们是Z世代，正在用自己的方式进入这个行业，无论是通过YouTube文化还是其他途径。」「他们从零开始，亲手创作。我想参与这样的创作。」

paragraphs.en: The Face/Off star's time in the live-action Spider-Noir may have come to an end, but it won't be long before we see him on our screens again. Cage is attached to star in Madden as John Madden in what may be his final project with Amazon MGM. He's also expected to appear in the next season of True Detective , and he'll lend his voice chops to the Marvel universe once again when he shows up for Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse in 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 这位《变脸》主演在真人剧集《暗影蜘蛛侠》中的演出或许已经结束，但我们很快就能再次在荧幕上见到他。凯奇将主演《Madden》，饰演John Madden，这或许会成为他与亚马逊米高梅合作的最后一部作品。他预计还会出演下一季《真探》，并在2027年的《蜘蛛侠：超越宇宙》中再次为漫威宇宙献声。

paragraphs.en: Cage commented on Spider-Noir's cancellation shortly after the news broke: "For me, one season is perfect, having said what I wanted to say with this dangerous, innovative, pop-art Spider-Man. Onwards, upwards, inwards."
paragraphs.cn: 《暗影蜘蛛侠》被取消的消息传出后不久，凯奇回应道：「对我来说，一季刚刚好。我已经通过这个危险、富有创新精神、带着波普艺术风格的蜘蛛侠，说出了我想说的话。向前，向上，向内。」
